name: qairline
description: QAirline monorepo: API Gateway + microservices (run locally without Docker)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,gateway,flight,booking,user,offer -c white,green,cyan,magenta,yellow,blue "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w api-gateway" "npm run dev -w services/flight-service" "npm run dev -w services/booking-service" "npm run dev -w services/user-service" "npm run dev -w services/offer-service"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n flight,booking,user,offer -c cyan,magenta,yellow,blue "npm run dev -w services/flight-service" "npm run dev -w services/booking-service" "npm run dev -w services/user-service" "npm run dev -w services/offer-service"
